RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making it virtually impossible that sex played a role in selecting him over you. Raising the all-male panel to imply gender bias is unfounded and would harm your professional reputation.

While an all-male panel may reflect broader departmental gender imbalances or a potential breach of internal rules regarding committee diversity, it does not demonstrate discrimination against you. The selection was likely driven by specific department needs—such as the cited industry experience—or interview performance. 

Focus your follow-up inquiries strictly on requesting constructive feedback regarding your qualifications and fit, rather than challenging the panel's demographics.
